strict.description: Default profile (blocking). constructorMaxDependencies считается только по сервисным классам — record-DTO исключены чекером. methodLocToleranceFactor гасит boundary-friction на round-number LOC-лимитах. Architecturally-структурные surfaces легализованы через pathOverrides ниже (EF Core adapter layer, REST controllers, MCP tool surfaces) — каждый с rationale, привязанным к ADR. Throne.Domain включён в size/CC-бюджет (override ниже): rich-DDD стиль (ADR-0025) охраняется DomainEncapsulationRulesTests (NetArchTest) на уровне инвариантов, а LOC/CC ловит разрастание агрегатов.

pathOverrides._comment: intent:4b43b94c4a194a30b8ddb99c67643d7f — NSwag-generated REST controllers compose one abstract override per route, so ctor surface grows linearly with endpoint count.
MCP tool surfaces ship as one class per tool group and inject the underlying handler/service deps; ctor fan-out is by design (см. specs/AGENTS.local.md MCP tools).

ADR-0047: EF Core adapter layer contains entity configurations, row POCOs, projection mappers and repository fragments. Slightly wider per-method/type budgets cover LINQ projection/configuration boilerplate while keeping adapter complexity bounded.
MCP keep-alive middleware embeds a SerializingWriteStream nested type that mirrors the Stream public API.

CLI provider façades (ADR-0024 gh, ADR-0032 glab) mechanically implement IGitProvider as one-line delegations to collaborator types; public surface == interface method count, same structural-surface precedent as REST controllers above.

ADR-0040: NSwag-generated controllers с одним OpenAPI tag дают one-class-per-tag диспатчер; public surface == route count. IntentRepositoriesController покрывает 16 routes (binding lifecycle + PR + review threads + commits) — single аггрегат с точки зрения клиента. Split на 3 контроллера потребовал бы tag-split в OpenAPI + регенерации TS-клиента и churn 7 frontend-консьюмеров; вынесено как follow-up. Структурная surface, не code-smell.

ADR-0040: NSwag-generated one-class-per-tag dispatcher; public surface == route count. SettingsController aggregates every settings route (workspace, terminal, skill defaults, local model, git providers, task-trackers) as one client-facing axis. Same structural-surface precedent as IntentRepositoriesController above — splitting would force an OpenAPI tag-split + TS-client regen, not a real decomposition.

ApiErrorRegistry is a flat error-code → HTTP-status lookup table; the StatusByCode initializer grows one dict entry per wire error code (zero branching, CC trivial). Same registry precedent as ErrorCodes — method LOC tracks the error catalogue size, not logic complexity.

ADR-0040: Throne.Domain включён в size/CC-бюджет (rich-DDD стиль через ADR-0025 + DomainEncapsulationRulesTests). Лимиты дают воздух для агрегатов (Intent 331 LOC, IntentRepositoryBinding 321, DreamSession.Create 109/CC 20, PromptPart ctor=9 data fields) при сохранении сигнала на дальнейшее разрастание. record-DTO и encapsulation охраняет NetArchTest, не budget.
Application handlers orchestrate UoW + domain calls + persistence; HandleAsync commonly covers a single logical transaction. Ctor surface lands within the base limit (8).
Pin/Move handlers ship as one file per command group, with multiple AddPin/RemovePin/MovePin handlers in the same file.
DI composition root concentrates Application service registrations.
ErrorCodes is a typed registry of wire-string constants; public surface = error catalogue size.

TerminalAgentCatalog is a typed registry of vendor / effort / model-source discriminators + descriptor lookups; public surface == (vendors + efforts + model-sources + helpers). Same precedent as ErrorCodes — registry-like type, growth tracks supported vendor count.
EF Core row POCOs mirror persisted column count one-to-one; public surface == table column count.
Test fixtures + WebApplicationFactory orchestration co-locate setup with cases; CA1502 globs cover analyzer side, here we relax LOC/CC for the test type itself.

legacy.description: Сохранён на случай emergency rollback. Default profile — strict.

pathOverrides._comment: REST-контроллеры композируют по одному endpoint-классу на route. С 10+ routes ctor неизбежно держит >8 deps; это арифметика surface area NSwag-generated абстрактного базового класса, а не code smell. Per-method limits остаются.
